input.summary: Complete the lower-right bank and lock at the left saucer, complete the lower-left bank and lock at the top-left saucer, then use 3x playfield scoring to finish the ordered Bonus X banks before repeating the orbit.

quickInfo.name: First lock
quickInfo.summary: Complete the lower-right four-bank, then shoot the left saucer to lock the first ball.

quickInfo.name: Second lock
quickInfo.summary: After the first lock, complete the lower-left four-bank and shoot the top-left saucer to lock the second ball.

quickInfo.name: Eclipse Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After both locks, plunge the third ball to start three-ball play with 3x playfield scoring, which becomes 2x playfield scoring with two balls.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X order
quickInfo.summary: Collect the left saucer for 2x, center three-bank for 3x, upper-right four-bank for 4x, and upper-left five-bank for 5x.

quickInfo.name: Orbit value
quickInfo.summary: Complete the upper target banks to light the lower-right standup that activates the orbit value feature.

steps.text: Complete the lower-right four-bank. Use the left flipper when it gives the cleanest angle.
Shoot the left saucer to lock the first ball.
After the lock, complete the lower-left four-bank. Earlier hits on this bank do not count.
Shoot the top-left saucer to lock the second ball. Plunge to start Eclipse Multiball.
During Eclipse Multiball, complete the flashing Bonus X stage in order.
modeNotes: Eclipse Multiball: Lock two balls, then plunge the third ball. It gives 3x playfield scoring with three balls and 2x playfield scoring with two balls.
Bonus X: Collect the left saucer, center three-bank, upper-right four-bank, and upper-left five-bank in that order.

steps.text: After Bonus X reaches 5x, repeat the orbit to the upper playfield.

fallback.title: Ordered bonus route
fallback.when: Use this when a lock saucer does not accept the ball or the lock sequence is not ready.

steps.text: Shoot the flashing Bonus X feature instead of an unlit bank.
Build base bonus with lanes and drop targets.
Stop after 5x and use upper-playfield orbit shots.
Return to the lock sequence when its required bank is active.

alternatives.title: Orbit-value route
alternatives.when: Use this after the upper banks are complete and the lower-right pad is safe.

steps.text: Complete the upper-right and upper-left target banks.
Hit the lower-right pad to activate the orbit value.
Repeat the orbit to the top while the return remains controlled.
Complete the two lock banks in their required order.
Lock two balls and plunge the third ball.
Preserve all three balls while you finish the Bonus X sequence.
Reach 5x, then use the orbit for continued scoring.

playfieldReferences.label: First-lock target bank
playfieldReferences.description: The lower-right four standups that qualify the first lock at the left saucer.

playfieldReferences.label: First lock saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The saucer above the upper-left flipper used for the first lock and the 2x Bonus X stage.

playfieldReferences.label: Second lock saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-left saucer that accepts the second lock after the lower-left bank is completed.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-playfield orbit
playfieldReferences.description: The lower-right-to-top orbit used after its value is activated.

techniques.name: Left-flipper lock setup
techniques.instruction: Move the ball to the left flipper for the lower-right bank and first lock sequence.

techniques.name: Right-flipper Multiball setup
techniques.instruction: During Multiball, use the right flipper for the required target banks when it gives the direct angle.

cautions.issue: Every required target bank can send an uncontrolled rebound toward a drain.
cautions.response: Shoot only the active bank. Use Multiball protection for the later banks when possible.

cautions.issue: The center three-bank has a difficult angle and a post below it.
cautions.response: Shoot it from a controlled flipper. Do not repeat it after a weak or post-bound rebound.

cautions.issue: The saucer feeds are usually safe, but a rare machine can behave differently.
cautions.response: Watch the first eject from each saucer. Trap the return before you continue the sequence.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the 1982 Gottlieb Eclipse, not Black Hole, plus ball count, Extra Ball and Special handling, tilt, and tournament scoring.
Confirm both virtual locks, ordered Bonus X lamps, orbit-value activation, and 3x-to-2x playfield scoring transition during Multiball.
Test both saucer ejects, all required target banks, the post below the center three-bank, and the orbit return before choosing the route.
input.simpleOverview: Eclipse requires two banks and two saucers in order before the third ball begins three-ball play with 3x scoring. Complete the lower-right bank and left-saucer lock, then the lower-left bank and top-left lock, and use Multiball to finish the ordered 2x-through-5x Bonus sequence.
input.overview: Eclipse requires two banks and two saucers in order before the third ball begins three-ball play with 3x scoring. Complete the lower-right bank and left-saucer lock before the lower-left bank and top-left lock, then plunge the third ball. Preserve all three balls while collecting the left saucer, center three-bank, upper-right four-bank, and upper-left five-bank for 2x through 5x, then use the lit orbit.
